status: deferred by root after training-only feasibility pilot; no gain forecast
idea: Conditioned event-time localization over individual cached track observations with an explicit nonphysical recording fallback.

novelty.current: Frozen temporal CNN pools point encodings with mean/max then regresses an unconstrained residual; no point-aligned target supervision or explicit normalized event time readout.
novelty.not_existing_physical_bypass: Four hand-built aggregate clocks are replaced here by a distribution learned over up to128 actual observation times.
novelty.not_failed_auxiliary_modes: That screen used11 global AOBT-offset thresholds and schedule-copy targets on156 tabular inputs; it had no trajectory localization.
novelty.not_arrival_stop_pilot: No new raw witness or prior-arrival aggregation is built.

interpretation: Recorded-block event is within observed time hull for49.17% of ordinary rows, but actual raw absence creates67minute median bracket gaps.
12.13% have two-sided observations within120s;19.84% have any retained observation within60s. These descriptive widths are not candidate gates.
Candidate potential is concentrated at EHAM/EDDF/EDDM/LSZH; this pilot gives almost no fine recording-event evidence at LFPG/LIRF and none at LTFM.
The two-day training-only sample is not a Jan/Jul coverage estimate and contains seasonal/airport source-coverage differences.
Recorded event can precede first observed movement or differ from physical pushback; observation hull must never be a hard output bound.

minimal_experiment.population: Unchanged original ordinary training rows; all held rows retained through original final stack.
minimal_experiment.features: Exactly original156 plus unchanged frozen2hour raw tracks. No new source, identity, threshold or labels as inputs.
minimal_experiment.model: Retain original point encoder and tabular branch. Replace mean/max readout with a tabular-conditioned attention over individual point encodings, each linked to its exact takeoff-minus-observation age, plus one unrestricted tabular fallback token. Retain missing masks and force fallback for0/1point histories.
minimal_experiment.readout: Conditional mean over observation-time components and an unrestricted learned fallback duration; point branch is not asserted to be physical truth. No physical-bound clipping.
minimal_experiment.loss: Original standardized clipped-target MSE only for the initial architecture screen; no additional ordinal/copy losses or tuned auxiliary coefficient.
minimal_experiment.gate: Learned fallback probability; never an airport/count/error-selected hard gate.
minimal_experiment.control: Saved same-desktop sparse156 seed42k0 for both months; original early stopping21/17 and24epoch OneCycle horizon.
minimal_experiment.score: Primary equal-size .5candidate-single+.5calls15 versus .5saved-sparse-single+.5calls15, with unchanged selected calls-LGB/Rome stack; actual selected sparse3/calls15 score separately.
minimal_experiment.falsification: Stop if both-month matched gain is absent or fixedhalf does not beat actual selected recipe beyond numerical variation; retain fixed bracketing/airport diagnostics, do not rescue with new gates.
minimal_experiment.runtime: Estimated18–25min desktop for twofits including encoding, based on saved sparse k0 fits10.08+6.02min. New head is smaller than CNN backbone; benchmark once beforefullfit. No rebuild/transfer needed.

recommendation: Defer training. Preserve fallback-attention design and descriptive evidence; no performance or remaining-goal gain is forecast.
